description: Whole-game scaffolding (packages/core/docs/whole-game-scaffolding.md §7): which pacing stage of a scaffolded game is open, which of the objectives it seeded the player may work on, whether the start state’s reasons still hold, and whether the game has ended and as what. Each kb mirrors packages/core/src/scaffold/scaffold-predicates.ts verbatim and is regenerated by `npm run scaffold-corpus`. The pack is unlike every other one here in that it evaluates AUTHORED goals: a gate and an end condition are terms a creator wrote, reached through scaffold_holds/1 (catch(call(G), _, fail)), so what these cases pin is not a mechanic but the shell around whichever mechanics a genre selected. Two properties matter more than the rest. A goal that RAISES — a gate naming a predicate no active pack defines — reads as a closed gate rather than as an error, because a creator switching a mechanic off must not crash a playthrough. And nothing is banked: a stage is open because the world is a certain way right now, so a gate whose condition lapses closes again, which is what lets a creator retune one mid-playthrough. The negative cases are the file’s teeth — an implementation that answered “open” to every gate passes every positive case here and hands the player the whole game at minute one. What this file cannot pin is a playthrough: no rule sequences one, and src/conformance/__tests__/headless-scaffold-host.test.ts is where a scaffolded game is played end to end.

cases.name: the-scaffold-in-play-is-the-one-the-kb-carries
kb: scaffold_start(S, Place, Role, Time) :- scaffold_start_place(S, Place), scaffold_start_role(S, Role), scaffold_start_time(S, Time).
scaffold_stage_open(S, Stage) :- scaffold_stage(S, Stage, _), scaffold_stage_gate(S, Stage, Gate), scaffold_holds(Gate).
scaffold_stage_blocked(S, Stage) :- scaffold_stage(S, Stage, _), \+ scaffold_stage_open(S, Stage).
scaffold_current_stage(S, Stage) :- scaffold_stage_open(S, Stage), scaffold_stage(S, Stage, N), \+ ( scaffold_stage_open(S, Other), scaffold_stage(S, Other, M), M > N ).
scaffold_objective_unlocked(S, Key) :- scaffold_stage_unlocks(S, Stage, Key), scaffold_stage_open(S, Stage), !.
scaffold_objective_available(S, Key) :- scaffold_objective(S, Key, _, _, _), scaffold_objective_unlocked(S, Key).
scaffold_objective_locked(S, Key) :- scaffold_objective(S, Key, _, _, _), \+ scaffold_objective_unlocked(S, Key).

scaffold_progress(S, Available, Total) :- scaffold(S), findall(A, scaffold_objective_available(S, A), Open), length(Open, Available), findall(T, scaffold_objective(S, T, _, _, _), All), length(All, Total).
scaffold_ending_reached(S, Key, Outcome) :- scaffold_ending(S, Key, Outcome), scaffold_ending_when(S, Key, When), scaffold_holds(When).

cases.name: the-win-condition-fires-when-the-world-meets-it
kb: scaffold_start(S, Place, Role, Time) :- scaffold_start_place(S, Place), scaffold_start_role(S, Role), scaffold_start_time(S, Time).
scaffold_stage_open(S, Stage) :- scaffold_stage(S, Stage, _), scaffold_stage_gate(S, Stage, Gate), scaffold_holds(Gate).
scaffold_stage_blocked(S, Stage) :- scaffold_stage(S, Stage, _), \+ scaffold_stage_open(S, Stage).
scaffold_current_stage(S, Stage) :- scaffold_stage_open(S, Stage), scaffold_stage(S, Stage, N), \+ ( scaffold_stage_open(S, Other), scaffold_stage(S, Other, M), M > N ).
scaffold_objective_unlocked(S, Key) :- scaffold_stage_unlocks(S, Stage, Key), scaffold_stage_open(S, Stage), !.
scaffold_objective_available(S, Key) :- scaffold_objective(S, Key, _, _, _), scaffold_objective_unlocked(S, Key).
scaffold_objective_locked(S, Key) :- scaffold_objective(S, Key, _, _, _), \+ scaffold_objective_unlocked(S, Key).

scaffold_progress(S, Available, Total) :- scaffold(S), findall(A, scaffold_objective_available(S, A), Open), length(Open, Available), findall(T, scaffold_objective(S, T, _, _, _), All), length(All, Total).
scaffold_ending_reached(S, Key, Outcome) :- scaffold_ending(S, Key, Outcome), scaffold_ending_when(S, Key, When), scaffold_holds(When).
